companyDescription: Commercial CNS/derm pharma · Fanapt, HETLIOZ, newly approved BYSANTI (bipolar I / schizophrenia), and imsidolimab (IL-36R antibody for generalized pustular psoriasis) awaiting a Dec 12 PDUFA — a revenue-generating company trading near 52-week lows
priceNote: Live $4.055 (+1.1%) at Oct 26, 2026 open — barely above the $3.875 52-week low (high $9.94), after the Oct 14 VQW-765 Phase 3 miss. Market cap ~$245M on 60.5M shares vs $170M Jun 30 cash and a $240-290M 2026 revenue guide.
summary: Vanda trades at ~1x sales near its 52-week low, with three revenue lines (Fanapt +23% YoY in Q2, HETLIOZ, newly launched BYSANTI) and a Dec 12, 2026 PDUFA for imsidolimab in GPP. That BLA is backed by positive GEMINI-1/2 Phase 3 data, so the binary leans favorable. fda_decision is a Tier-2 LEADER in turbo feedback (+9.3pp median excess vs SPY vs +2.0pp overall, n=10). Survival check passes: $170M cash and company-guided funding through 2027, so no flag. The honest weakness is that a GPP approval alone is too small to triple the stock. The moonshot needs BYSANTI traction plus approval to re-rate a heavily loss-making (H1 net loss $111M) company. Base (+50%) exceeds the lane's realized 30-day P90 (+25.9%; written-Base bias +72.7pp). It assumes a 3-6 month horizon of approval plus the first BYSANTI quarters, re-rating toward the $6 area. แนะนำ 3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า thesis fail ลงได้ 30-50%.

catalysts.name: Imsidolimab BLA — PDUFA (GPP)
catalysts.description: IL-36 receptor antibody for generalized pustular psoriasis, licensed from AnaptysBio. Supported by the positive GEMINI-1/2 Phase 3 trials (single IV dose cleared skin; effect maintained ~2 years on monthly dosing). Orphan indication; modeled approval odds are high.

catalysts.name: BYSANTI commercial launch
catalysts.description: BYSANTI (milsaperidone) was approved Q1 2026 for bipolar I and schizophrenia, with launch in H2 2026. Early script data is the bridge between the PDUFA and the re-rating.

catalysts.name: HETLIOZ DSWPD positive Phase 3 → sNDA
catalysts.description: Phase 3 in delayed sleep-wake phase disorder met its primary endpoint (sleep onset advanced 37.1 min vs placebo, p=0.022) — a label-expansion filing candidate.

risks: Losses are heavy: H1 2026 net loss of $111.1M (Q2 alone $62.5M) against $170M cash at Jun 30. The 'funded through 2027' guide depends on revenue growth and on expenses falling as promised from late 2026.
The VQW-765 social-anxiety Phase 3 failed on Oct 14, 2026. That program is on hold, and the pipeline-credibility discount has widened.
GPP is an ultra-rare indication with an approved competitor (spesolimab/Spevigo), so imsidolimab's revenue ceiling is modest. Approval alone is not a 3x catalyst.
The BYSANTI launch competes in a crowded antipsychotic market against generics. Early scripts may disappoint.
Vanda has a long history of FDA disputes and litigation. Management's regulatory posture adds idiosyncratic risk around any decision.

estimateDates.note: Third commercial launch in 12 months if approved

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Revenue-generating specialty pharma ($240-290M 2026 guide) with $170M cash, so it is less financing-dependent than the rest of this run. Rates matter mainly through small-cap risk appetite and launch-spend tolerance.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the macro tape matters less than execution. Oct 28 hold is priced; a hawkish surprise would weigh on the small-cap multiple, not solvency.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · ค่าขนม 3% max — the best downside floor this run (revenue + cash ≈ the market cap) with a favorable Dec 12 PDUFA, but the 3x case needs BYSANTI execution, not just approval. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($3.70-3.90, at the 52-week low) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Little run-up so far. VNDA sits near its 52-week low after the Oct 14 VQW-765 social-anxiety Phase 3 miss (-9.9% over the past month), so the PDUFA is not crowded.

postWin.note: PharmaTher gained 148% in the six months after its Aug 2025 ketamine approval — a micro-cap reference. VNDA is a multi-product company, so a single orphan approval is unlikely to move it as much on its own; the re-rating needs BYSANTI traction alongside it.

postLose.note: Average of Capricor -33% (Jul 11, 2025 CRL) and Outlook -80% (Dec 31, 2025 CRL). VNDA has more cushion than either — $170M cash (~$2.8/share) plus $240-290M of revenue — so a CRL likely lands toward the milder end.

spotSizing.reason: 3%. The fda_decision bucket is a Tier-2 LEADER (+9.3pp median excess vs SPY vs +2.0pp overall, n=10). The revenue base and cash give the best downside floor in this run, but the weak lane scoreboard (hitRate 4.9%, n=41) caps it at 3%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the fda_decision medianMAE (-18.4%, n=10). A break below ~$3.16 before Dec 12 means the cash/revenue floor isn't holding.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If FDA issues a CRL, or Q3/Q4 shows BYSANTI scripts stalling, exit. The thesis needs both legs.

risks: ขาดทุนหนัก: H1 2026 ขาดทุนสุทธิ $111.1M (Q2 อย่างเดียว $62.5M) เทียบเงินสด $170M ณ 30 มิ.ย. การบอกว่ามีเงินถึงปี 2027 ขึ้นกับรายได้ที่โตและค่าใช้จ่ายที่ต้องลดลงตามที่สัญญาไว้ตั้งแต่ปลายปี 2026
Phase 3 ของ VQW-765 ในโรควิตกกังวลทางสังคมล้มเหลว 14 ต.ค. 2026 โปรแกรมถูกพัก และความน่าเชื่อถือของ pipeline ถูกลดมูลค่ามากขึ้น
GPP เป็นโรคหายากมาก และมีคู่แข่งที่ได้อนุมัติแล้ว (spesolimab/Spevigo) เพดานรายได้ของ imsidolimab จึงไม่สูง การอนุมัติอย่างเดียวไม่ใช่ catalyst 3 เท่า
BYSANTI เปิดตัวในตลาดยาต้านโรคจิตที่แออัดและแข่งกับ generic ยอดสั่งจ่ายช่วงแรกอาจผิดหวัง
Vanda มีประวัติขัดแย้งและฟ้องร้องกับ FDA ยาวนาน ท่าทีของผู้บริหารเพิ่มความเสี่ยงเฉพาะตัวรอบการตัดสินทุกครั้ง
